sections.title: Streaming Audio Advertising FAQs
sections.description: Common questions about advertising on streaming music and podcast platforms.

faqs.question: What platforms do streaming audio ads run on?
faqs.answer: Your streaming audio ads can run on major music streaming services and premium podcast networks. We help you select the best platform mix based on your target audience.

faqs.question: How much does streaming audio advertising cost?
faqs.answer: Streaming audio advertising costs vary based on targeting, platform selection, ad length, and campaign duration. Most campaigns start around $1,000-$2,500 per month with CPM rates typically ranging from $15-$35.

faqs.question: What's included in creative production?
faqs.answer: We handle complete audio ad production including strategy consultation, scriptwriting, professional voice talent, recording, sound design, music licensing, and final mixing. Production typically takes 7-10 business days.

faqs.question: Can I combine audio ads with other channels?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Streaming audio works great alongside social media advertising and connected TV for a comprehensive brand awareness strategy.
